explanation: He was nominated five times, the last in 1948, but never won. That year the committee gave no peace prize, saying there was no suitable living candidate.

claims.text: Mahatma Gandhi never received the Nobel Peace Prize.
Gandhi was nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize five times: in 1937, 1938, 1939, 1947 and 1948.
No Nobel Peace Prize was awarded in 1948.
In 1948 the Norwegian Nobel Committee declined to award the peace prize on the ground that there was no suitable living candidate.
